integrity: The proof and independently constructed finite spectral and lossy-propagation checks are included. The single-detector equal-weight square strongly regular case is known and explicitly credited. No independence, authorship or priority certification is claimed.
limitations: Finite-dimensional, positive real two-factor hopping, nonempty rectangular positive-rate loss; infinite-time capture only. Does not include arbitrary detector patterns, disorder, dephasing, interactions or uniform relaxation-time estimates.
title: Rectangular detectors on weighted rook quantum networks: exact resonance and capture laws
